Get geography names and ACS 5-year data for selected tables and fips or fipstype

Source: R/get_acs_new.R
get_acs_new_both.Rd

Get geography names and ACS 5-year data for selected tables and fips or fipstype

Usage

get_acs_new_both(
  tables = NULL,
  fips = "blockgroup",
  yr = acsdefaultendyearhere,
  fiveorone = 5
)

Arguments

tables

vector of ACS data table numbers like "B01001" etc. and if NULL, uses defaults of get_acs_new()

fips

"blockgroup" for all US bg, or a vector of fips codes. can also be "county", "state", "tract", or vector of one of those fips code types. If a fips type, defines the SUMLEVEL variable in the ACS data, such as 140 for tracts.

yr

end year of 5 year ACS summary file data, such as 2023 for the 2019-2023 survey released by Census Bureau Dec. 2024.

fiveorone

optional 1 or 5, where 5 is the 5-year sample - only 5-yr tested here

Value

list of geos + dat, with estimates and margins of error and fips and SUMLEVEL
